title: Topology of a Uniform Spanning Tree on a Cylinder
summary: We study uniform spanning trees (USTs) on the discrete cylinder $G_{n,m}=C_n\times P_m$, in the regime where the circumference \(n\) is fixed and the length $m$ tends to infinity. Using Wilson's algorithm, with the initial root on one boundary ring and the first walk started from the other, we single out a \emph{trunk} $L\subset T$: the first loop-erased random-walk path connecting the two boundary rings.
